sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Alsager sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are in dire form, having won only once in their last six outings. Despite Sandbach's recent loss, they remain clear leaders and should be firm favourites against struggling opponents.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town host Dawley Town at 15:00, looking to bounce back after their own recent loss and keep pace with leaders Sandbach. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall (sixth place) in a fixture between two strong sides, with Bridgnorth aiming to recover from consecutive defeats. Fourth-ranked Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community away at 15:00 in a local derby; Casuals are in good form with three consecutive wins. Bilston Town (fifth) entertain Foley Meir, with both sides showing mixed recent results. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a clash between mid-table sides, while Telford Town travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads—both teams struggling near the bottom. Crewe face Allscott Heath and Shawbury United host Barnton; Shawbury are in alarming form having lost five straight. A midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a 19:45 kick-off as the only evening game of the period.
